versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei抖音发现 skill.

- Enables keyword search, creator post fetching, comment analysis, and real-time hot topic queries for Douyin.
- Provides structured JSON output, suitable for content planning, competitor analysis, and public sentiment monitoring.
- Supports intent recognition from natural user input, even if "Douyin" is not explicitly mentioned.
- Implements strict token error handling with compliance-focused messaging; does not output marketing content or contact details at runtime.
- No third-party dependencies; requires only Node.js ≥ 16.14 and a valid GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- Limits: fetches up to 10,000 items per request, handles only public Douyin data, and does not support publishing, editing, or watermark removal.
